Package hadur117.mini.core

Class Move

java.lang.Object
hadur117.mini.core.Move
public final class Move extends Object
Deise's movement (DEISE-1 to DEISE-5): a least-risk point each tick from a ring of candidates. The risk of a point adds, for each live opponent, a push away from it, a cost for heading straight at or away from an opponent that is likely aiming at Deise, and the danger of the waves it was seen to fire (weighed by WAVES); with CORNERS, while the field is crowded, the distance to the nearest corner, so Deise holds Saor's corners early and comes out of them as the field thins. Since 0.3 the across term and the corners are off and the push is flat (docs/deise.md section 8). Pure: opponents are rows {x, y, energy} (null when unseen or dead), waves rows {x, y, fire time, speed, head-on angle, linear angle, weight} (null when free).

      public static boolean aimsAtUs(double[] bot, double distance, double[][] bots)

    • wave

      public static double[] wave(double ox, double oy, double time, double power, double bearing, double lateral, double weight)
      A wave fired at Deise from (ox, oy) at time with power, its bullet on Deise's head-on line or on the line that leads Deise's present motion (DEISE-5). bearing is the shooter's absolute bearing from Deise, so the head-on line is bearing + PI; lateral is Deise's speed across that line, its velocity times the sine of the shooter's bearing relative to Deise's heading. Its weight is 1 when the shooter likely aims at Deise and 0.25 otherwise.

    • danger

      public static double danger(double[] wave, double px, double py, double time, double r)
      r plus the danger of (px, py) from a wave: for each of its lines, where the bullet will be when it has come as far as the point, near the point is dangerous; a wave already past the point is not (DEISE-5). Each line adds to r in turn, as the shipped class sums it.
